description: This PHP source file defines a class RegistrationAPIClientService that provides methods to create an API client and publish data to a remote registration endpoint. It uses GuzzleHttp for HTTP requests and includes error handling and logging.

classes.name: RegistrationAPIClientService
classes.description: Provides functionality to initialize a Guzzle HTTP client and send registration data to a remote server, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: getApiClient
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Guzzle HTTP client configured with the registration URL. Implements singleton-like behavior to reuse the client.

methods.name: publishData
methods.description: Sends registration data via POST request to the registration API endpoint. Returns true if the request succeeds with status code 200, otherwise logs errors and returns false.
